App\\Models\\Product.description:

Key Features:

  • High Safety & Stability: LiFePO4 chemistry provides superior thermal and chemical stability, preventing overheating or explosion risks.

  • Long Cycle Life: Offers 2000+ deep discharge cycles while retaining over 80% capacity.

  • Consistent Output: Stable 3.2V nominal voltage output throughout discharge.

  • Eco-Friendly: Non-toxic, non-polluting, free from rare metals.

Ideal for Solar Power Systems, Inverters, Electric Cycles/Scooters, Portable Power Stations, Emergency Lighting, and Custom Series/Parallel Battery Packs (12V, 24V, 48V).
